universalPolicy.note: Only real drop/chest can issue these items. Shop previews may show locked collection info but must never offer Buy/Exchange.

partyEvent.existingDraftViolation: party_event_chest_or_exchange must be removed from issuing policy; existing hidden code is not release-ready

worldBoss.existingDraftViolation: V58 World Sigil equipment exchange quote contradicts chest-only requirement; remove/disable gear exchange before release

remarks: No gameplay/catalog/server manifests, SQL, shop routes, drops or Android assets changed by this review-only manifest.
Exact percentages/trait magnitudes require simulations and server-owned rollout; suggested multiplier ranges are not active equipment modifiers.
Class-specific weapons require separate compatibility review; dual-hand and offhand budget contracts remain unchanged.

dungeon.twoPiece: Small reliable performance edge vs ordinary craft gear with elite/boss utility
dungeon.threePiece: A conditional mechanic with explicit proc cooldown, no permanent high-damage amplification
dungeon.visual: Dungeon-specific material and emblem, not fake craft-tier recolor

partyEvents.strongerBonusCandidate: 2pc haste and 3pc once-per-window ability momentum, bound to event
2pc crit-damage, 3pc conditional execute below threshold with boss caps
2pc max HP, 3pc threshold-triggered barrier with cooldown
2pc ability power, 3pc low-chance bounded cooldown recovery

rewardSetDirection.notes: Numbers here are targets; do not enable or adjust actual chest odds or existing set procs until Combat/Rewards 2.0 server simulation and written approval.
